title: How do plants drink water?
examples: How do plants suck up water from the ground?
What part of the plant helps it drink water?
Do plants need water to live?

explain.say: Roots are the parts of a plant under the ground.
Roots have tiny hairs. The hairs soak up water from the soil.
The water moves up through the stems, inside tiny tubes.

draw.text: Stems move water up to leaves.

explain.say: The leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant.
Some water goes out through tiny holes in the leaves. This is called transpiration.
In a tall tree, water travels all the way up to the top leaves.

draw.text: Water travels from roots to leaves.

faq.q: Do plants drink water through their flowers?
faq.a: No. Plants take in water with their roots, under the ground.
asks: Where do plants get their water from?

faq.q: Is the stem the only thing that moves water?
faq.a: No. The roots take water in, the stem carries it up, and the leaves help pull it up.
asks: What moves water up the plant?
Does the stem move water alone?

faq.q: What is transpiration in simple words?
faq.a: Transpiration is when water goes out of the leaves into the air. This helps pull more water up from the roots.
asks: Why do leaves let water go?
What is the water leaving the leaves called?

faq.q: Do roots only grow in the soil?
faq.a: Most roots grow in soil, where they find water. Some plants, like water lilies, have roots in water.

faq.q: Does the amount of sunlight affect how much water is used?
faq.a: Yes. In bright sunshine, more water goes out of the leaves.
asks: Does sun help plants use water?
Is sunlight important for plant water?

facts: Roots are usually found underground to soak up water.
Stems transport water from the roots up to the leaves.
Leaves let water vapour out through tiny holes.
This water release process is called transpiration.

quiz.say: Which part of a plant takes in water first?
quiz.why: Roots soak up water from the soil.

wrong.0: Leaves make food, and water reaches them last.
wrong.2: Flowers make seeds, and water reaches them through the stem.

quiz.say: Water goes out of the leaves into the air. What is this called?
quiz.show: 🍃 💨 Water goes out into the air
quiz.why: Transpiration is water going out of the leaves into the air.

wrong.1: Photosynthesis is how leaves make food from sunlight.

quiz.say: A plant has strong roots. How do they help it in the wind?
quiz.why: Strong roots hold the plant firmly in the soil, so it stays standing.

wrong.0: Flowers grow from the stem, and roots hold the plant down.
wrong.1: Leaves change colour in autumn, and roots hold the plant down.
